compartment.title: Sandbox, Shell, and File System Substrate

paths.notes: generated at bundle/release time; not tracked in source

evidence.claim: The sandbox factory dispatches to a platform-specific manager only when sandbox.enabled; otherwise returns NoopSandboxManager, which still applies environment sanitization.
LocalSandboxManager is a placeholder that throws 'Tool sandboxing is not yet implemented.' and always reports commands as neither safe nor dangerous.
SandboxedFileSystemService routes every read/write through sandboxManager.prepareCommand with synthetic __read/__write programs and a per-op allowedPaths policy, then child_process.spawn.
ShellExecutionService is effectively a process-singleton via all-static state: active ptys, child processes, and a session-keyed backgroundProcessHistory; shellBackgroundTools reads from that map.
Governance and secret file protection is shared across platforms via GOVERNANCE_FILES + SECRET_FILES + findSecretFiles in sandboxManager.ts, reimported by every platform manager.

contradictions.description: Guideline lists bundle/sandbox-*.sb as a primary path but no .sb files are tracked in source; they are produced at bundle/release time.
Windows has its own commandSafety.ts separate from the shared utils/commandSafety.ts; sandboxManager.ts imports both under aliases.

risks.description: Background-process history is static and session-keyed; benchmark iterations reusing a sessionId can leak background state across runs.
risks.suggestedGuard: Benchmarks must use a fresh sessionId per iteration or call a reset helper.

risks.description: LocalSandboxManager.prepareCommand throws lazily; an unsupported platform produces a turn-level error only when the first tool runs.
risks.suggestedGuard: Surface 'unsupported platform' at factory time, not at first prepareCommand.

risks.description: SandboxedFileSystemService maps ENOENT by stderr substring matching; future sandbox wrappers with different stderr text will lose that signal.
risks.suggestedGuard: Add explicit exit-code mapping alongside substring detection.

observabilitySignals: debugLogger calls in sandboxedFileSystemService.ts / shellExecutionService.ts / platform sandbox managers
gaps: No integration test for cross-session backgroundProcessHistory isolation (R-10.1).
ENOENT substring heuristic in SandboxedFileSystemService not under test (R-10.3).

openQuestions: OQ-10.1: Does any advisor-driven tool in Pollux plan to spawn shell commands directly, bypassing ShellExecutionService? Escalate to 04 and 07.
OQ-10.2: Should benchmark runs force sandbox.enabled=false for A/E fairness, and is NoopSandboxManager env sanitization acceptable for perf numbers? Escalate to 14.

definitionOfDone.item: Sandbox architecture is mapped across modes and platforms.
Shell/background and filesystem pathways are documented.
Lifecycle and cleanup semantics are evidence-backed.
Pre-flight path validation recorded in report section 0.
Evidence matrix populated in the JSON sidecar.
